privacy_intro: Mosmos collects only the minimum information below, for waitlist registration.
privacy_items: Your email address, your consent and when you signed up, how you reached us (the link's UTM source, medium and campaign values, and, if you came from another site, that page's address without its query string), and the page language (used only to pick the language of the welcome email; not stored)
privacy_purpose: To send launch news, the welcome email and access emails, and to count which channels brought you here
privacy_consent: Without your consent we don't store your sign-up. You can withdraw consent at any time.
privacy_optional: Survey answers, such as your work, what you mostly use AI for, your country, how many AI services you use and the first thing you'd hand off, are optional. We use them only to prepare a service that fits you better.
privacy_retention: We delete all waitlist data at once when the full service opens. If you ask before then, we delete yours right away.
privacy_processors: Notion stores sign-ups, Resend sends our emails, Vercel hosts the site and counts visits anonymously, and Upstash limits how often requests can be made. Upstash keeps your IP address for one minute only. Some of these servers are in other countries.
privacy_contact: To have your registration removed, withdraw consent or ask anything else, email us at the address below.
survey_intro: This helps us prepare something that fits you better. Everything is optional.

faq_1_a: There's no set date or order yet. We'll let you know by email as we roll out gradually.
faq_2_q: How is it different from a chat AI?
faq_2_a: With a chat AI, you ask it directly and polish its answers yourself. Mos asks only what you need to decide, puts together a team of AI workers for the job and brings the results back.
faq_3_a: Terms and pricing haven't been set yet. Once they are, you'll hear about them by email first.
faq_4_a: AIs that each go deep on one kind of work, such as writing, design or research. For each job, Mos calls in the workers it needs and puts together a team, then forms a new one for the next job. When needed, workers ask each other questions and hand work over.
faq_5_q: Which languages can I use it in?
faq_5_a: We're getting it ready in Korean, English and Japanese.
faq_6_a: Mos asks before deleting any file. While it works on a task, the task details and files may be sent to AI providers. Task results stay in the task folder in your Mosmos storage.
final_title: Keep the decisions, hand Mos the rest
